sentences.en: Sami and Layla argued over the custody of their children.
sentences.zh: 萨米和莱拉为孩子的监护权发生了争执。

sentences.en: As for the papers, I have custody of them.
sentences.zh: 至于那些文件，我保管着它们。

sentences.en: The police have one of the kidnappers in custody.
sentences.zh: 警方已经拘留了一名绑匪。

senses.zh: 监护权，抚养权；拘留，羁押；保管，保护；监管，看管
